name: siren-and-pulse
style: Instrumental dark industrial ambient cue, 17 seconds, all electronic. Lead voice is a filtered warning siren far off across a dead town, a slow wail that climbs and sinks, smeared in long cold reverb and lo-fi grain. Underneath, a looping sub-bass throb at slow heartbeat pace, 60 bpm, hypnotic and patient. Cue sheet: 0s distant siren drifting over the low throb and a faint fluorescent electrical hum; 6s the throb tightens and quickens, a hard muffled metallic thud lands at 6s, 8s and 10s like a tube flickering; 12s the siren swells nearer, louder, rawer, rust and static in its tail; 15s one huge crashing hit; 15.5s to 17s dead silence.
exclude: strings, piano, guitar, vocals, choir, singing, melody, acoustic instruments, drum kit, orchestra, upbeat, major key
